properties.value: Genuine MD5 in a security context: the vendored EVP_BytesToKey (parse-asn1/crypto-browserify, ipfs.js:10493) iterates MD5 to derive cipher key+IV from a user passphrase, decrypting legacy 'Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED' PEM private keys in browserify-sign's parseKeys flow. properties.value: All 8 sites are genuine Math.random() uses, but none generate key material: 10389 is core-js $fails feature detection, 7084 is core-js's uid/Symbol generator, 28971-28975 are cycle.js decycle escape markers, and 42984 generates a multipart HTTP boundary (protocol delimiter, predictable but not a security token). The bundle uses randomBytes (CSPRNG) for all crypto randomness (OAEP seeds, PKCS#1 padding bytes, salts). Recorded as real weak-PRNG sites at low severity; the object's 'security context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Vendored crypto-browserify pbkdf2 compat module (21365-21386) — PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1 by default ('digest = digest || sha1') — used by parse-asn1's decrypt() (compat.pbkdf2Sync at 10660) to unwrap passphrase-encrypted PEM keys.
